description: Welcome to My Veranda, a stylish 130m² duplex with 4 warmly decorated bedrooms, ideal for families, groups or business stays. Located in the Grands Boulevards district, just a 10-min walk from the Haut Marais, it offers a quiet and central base to explore Paris. Fully equipped with A/C, high-speed Wi-Fi, washer/dryer, a modern kitchen, smart TV and generous natural light by the glass canopy , it blends design, space and comfort in one of the city’s most vibrant neighborhoods.The space> The Space – My VerandaWelcome to My Veranda, a fully renovated 130m² design duplex nestled in the lively Grands Boulevards district, just a 10-minute walk from the trendy Haut Marais. This spacious and stylish apartment was redesigned using high-quality materials and offers modern amenities and thoughtful details to make you feel at home.Whether you’re traveling with family, friends, or colleagues, the apartment offers everything you need for a relaxing and independent stay: air conditioning throughout, high-speed Wi-Fi, a fully equipped kitchen, washer/dryer, and three modern bathrooms.> Living AreaComfortable living room with a large sofa (can be converted into a bed for 2), 2 armchairs, 3 ottomans, and a smart TVDining area with a rectangular table and 8 chairsModern kitchen with fridge, freezer, oven, microwave, stovetop, dishwasher, coffee machine, kettle, toaster, blender, and full cookware + ample storage> Bedrooms & Sleeping ArrangementsBedroom 1 (main floor): King-size bed (180x200), 2 nightstands, smart TV, work deskBedroom 2 (main floor): Queen-size bed (160x200), 2 nightstands, smart TV, work deskBedroom 3 (upstairs): Two single beds (90x200), dresserBedroom 4 (upstairs): Queen-size bed (160x200), 2 wardrobes, smart TV, work deskConvertible sofa in the living room for 2 additi
